mode.title: Mode
mode.description: posts = an account's posts; profiles = profile details; followers / following = an account's graph; searchAccounts = find accounts by keyword.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Bluesky handles or profile URLs, e.g. bsky.app or https://bsky.app/profile/bsky.app.

searchQueries.title: Account search queries (mode: searchAccounts)
searchQueries.description: Keywords to search account names, handles and bios.

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max items per account / query
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Posts, followers, or search hits per account or query.

sinceDate.title: Only posts since (mode: posts)
sinceDate.description: ISO date, e.g. 2026-01-01. Older posts are skipped and paging stops.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Include the account's replies to other posts.

includeReposts.title: Include reposts
includeReposts.description: Include reposts of other accounts' posts.
